title: Status hub views (views.yml)
description: The status hub shell: a main page and a left menu of views (ADR-0013). A view is a built-in panel (exceptions-first summary, per-module grid, source table) over a selection of the registered status sources, or an external link entry naming a registry service. Nothing here acts: the hub is read-only. 1.1 adds the live agent-activity pages as panels (agents, activity, agent-analytics; agent-detail and agent-access-log, which must sit in the private group and render only for an authorized request) and the optional menu group. 1.2 adds the strategy pages as panels (strategy, requirements, objectives, rfis: homelabnext.strategy.pages, served by hnx status serve --strategy DIR). 1.3 adds the baselines page as a panel (the guest x defense-layer coverage matrix: homelabnext.compute.pages, served by hnx status serve --guests DIR --guests-site SITE). 1.4 adds the approvals page as a panel (the broker Approvals page, ADR-0017 stage 2b: homelabnext.status.approvals, served when agents.yml configures approvals), which must sit in the private group. 1.5 adds the generated map pages as panels (topology, dataflow, architecture, roadmap: homelabnext.status.maps, ADR-0018; the topology served with hnx status serve --guests DIR --guests-site SITE, the other three with --maps ROOT; hnx status render also writes them as static files). 1.6 adds the projects page as a panel (open projects with step progress, blocked work, work by strategy record: homelabnext.projects.pages, served by hnx status serve --projects DIR). 1.7 adds the directory pages as panels (links, schedule, roster: the service link directory, every scheduled job with its cadence and last/next run, the agent roster; homelabnext.status.maps, served with hnx status serve --maps ROOT and written by hnx status render). Evolve additively.

main.description: The view shown as the main page; must be a panel view.

act_via.description: Optional: where anything that changes something is done (the broker or approval path). The hub only links to it.

service.description: A registry service name; the link is built from the registry (public hostname, else the capability alias).

optional.description: When the service is not registered the entry is shown as unavailable instead of failing validation (agents and their dashboards are optional).

panel.description: exceptions, grid and sources are sections of the page; the agent panels (1.1), the strategy panels (1.2), the baselines panel (1.3), the approvals panel (1.4), the map panels (1.5), the projects panel (1.6) and the directory panels (1.7) are pages of their own, served live by hnx status serve.

group.description: 1.1: a menu group; the private group renders only for a request through the trusted front door.
